content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-80. - Evaluation of job performance.
content.summary:
The city council shall be entitled to evaluate the presiding municipal judge at least
               once annually. The city council may evaluate the associate municipal judge and relief
               judges at any time.
(Code 1981, § 18-49; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
